entities.summary: Asclepiades (b. 150 BCE, Apamea Myrlea) was a political leader or statesperson of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Apamea Myrlea. Known in the fields of journalists & chroniclers.
